name: National Youth Corps
benefit: An honorarium of ₹ 5000 per month is provided for serving up to two years (including the period of training which will be for 4 weeks) in the identified development activities on a full-time basis.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be between 18 - 29 years of age.
1. The applicant must have passed Class 10th.
